LanguageData.RK_Scenario_Settler.label: Ratkin settlers
LanguageData.RK_Scenario_Settler.description: Five Ratkins set out from their homeland to find a new place to call home. They have put everything past them and hope to write a new story in the vast expanse of this world. They begin with a few materials and some tools.
LanguageData.RK_Scenario_Settler.scenario.summary: A small group of Ratkin leave home to start a new life.

LanguageData.RK_Scenario_Settler.scenario.parts.15.te: After walking for many miles, the five ratkin stop at here after coming to the conclusion that this is the spot. This is the place where they will make their new home.
